doc: Streaming PCM output. The guest opens a stream and pushes interleaved samples; the host plays them in order.

constants.name: ERR_ARGS
constants.doc: rate or channel count out of range, unknown format, or samples not a whole number of frames

constants.name: ERR_HANDLE
constants.doc: not an open stream of this instance

constants.name: ERR_UNAVAILABLE
constants.doc: the host has no audio output

functions.name: open
functions.doc: Opens a stream with `channels` (1 or 2) interleaved channels at `rate` Hz. Returns a stream handle (> 0) or ERR_*.

functions.name: push
functions.doc: Appends samples in `format` (SAMPLE_*). Returns the number of frames queued, or ERR_*.

functions.name: queued
functions.doc: Frames pushed but not yet played, as far as the host can tell (for back-pressure); ERR_HANDLE for a bad handle.

functions.name: close
functions.doc: Stops and releases the stream. A bad handle is ignored.
